entries.title: Mortal Shell
entries.definitive_edition: Mortal Shell: Digital Deluxe Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with The Virtuous Cycle and Rotten Autumn content available.

primary.version: Digital Deluxe Edition / base game plus The Virtuous Cycle
primary.why: The Windows PC Digital Deluxe route is the best main-play version because it keeps native PC capture/settings flexibility and bundles the base game with The Virtuous Cycle expansion; the free Rotten Autumn update content is also part of the modern content set. The Switch Complete Edition is convenient because it bundles all updates and DLC, and the PS5/Xbox Series Enhanced Edition adds 4K/60 console upgrades, but neither adds sourced exclusive game content over a complete PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Mortal Shell: Digital Deluxe Edition on Steam, install Mortal Shell and The Virtuous Cycle, then play the native Windows PC build with the Rotten Autumn update content present.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC release; Steam Digital Deluxe bundles the base game and The Virtuous Cycle expansion.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete PC route with The Virtuous Cycle plus PC settings/capture flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Original console releases for the same base game generation.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced exclusive game content over the complete Windows PC route.

all_releases.fidelity: Enhanced Edition console route with 4K visuals, 60fps target on PS5/Xbox Series X, enhanced textures, and PS5 DualSense features.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console presentation, but no sourced exclusive missions/levels over the complete Windows PC route.

all_releases.fidelity: Cloud access route for Mortal Shell: Enhanced Edition.
all_releases.reason: skip: cloud access route, not the preferred archival/capture route versus native PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Complete Edition bundles all content updates and DLC on Switch.
all_releases.reason: skip: complete portable route, but PC Digital Deluxe covers the DLC while preserving PC fidelity/capture flexibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Switch Complete Edition bundles all updates and DLC, but the Windows PC Digital Deluxe route also includes the major paid DLC and keeps the preferred PC fidelity/capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced Edition is a console upgrade for PS5/Xbox Series X|S rather than a PC replacement; Switch Complete Edition is complete but not the fidelity-first pick.
